description: Canonical reference license texts. An artifact license may be marked VERIFIED only when the license text fetched by the catalog-refresh CI job is byte-identical (sha256) to one of these files (match_mode 'exact'), or - for MIT only - identical after replacing the single copyright line with the template line (match_mode 'mit_copyright_line'); AND the model-card license metadata agrees with spdx_id. Everything else stays UNVERIFIED.

conditions: Apache-2.0 s.4: redistributors include the License, retain notices and mark changes
MIT: the copyright notice and permission notice must be included in all copies or substantial portions
